authority.Delta_B_logistics: mean of matched Impact-first minus Unconstrained deficit hours

cohorts.residential: Frozen formal Population > 0 AND archived housing_total > 0

standardization: cohort-specific arithmetic mean and population SD (ddof=0); no imputation, trimming, winsorization or zero replacement
cluster_labels: diagnostic-only; canonical order by mean B_480_hr then mean Population; never formal Stage 7 IDs
nonlinear_overlap: five-fold shuffled seed42 additive cubic spline + Ridge(alpha=1); descriptive random-tract CV, not spatial validation

stress_tests.asset_tail: leave cohort-specific top 1% BUILDVALUE (>=P99, ties retained) out of fitting only; fit scaler and kmeans on other tracts, predict all including held-out; all specifications/cohorts/k at seed42; not a revised eligibility rule
stress_tests.spatial: official frozen TIGER INTPTLAT/INTPTLON transformed to UTM11N; four median-x/median-y quadrants; leave one quadrant out, refit scaler and kmeans, predict all; positive cohort, all specifications/k, seed42; no geometry-based exclusions
stress_tests.high_initial_service: P99 Init_Supply enrichment and weighted total/between/within sum-of-squares contributions; no tail removal or transformation

decision_principle: RQ construct validity and evidence, not optimization of silhouette/ARI/k or agreement with manuscript narratives; no formal promotion
